mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process for constructing a granny suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planning a granny suite typically starts with an initial design consultation to evaluate your property's layout, discuss functional goals, and define the scope of work. Next, detailed construction drawings are developed to specify structural framing, plumbing lines for the bathroom, electrical capacity, and drywall placement. Once plans are established and permits are acquired, physical construction progresses from foundation or subfloor prep through rough plumbing, electrical rough-ins, insulation, and drywall installation. The final stages involve installing bathroom tile, fixtures, cabinetry, interior trim, and exterior finishes such as matching stucco or paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process starts with consultation and design planning, moves through permitting and rough structural work, and finishes with drywall, plumbing fixtures, and trim.
